name: duplicate-key-when-two-clients-create-at-once
scenario: Simultaneous creates occasionally hand back the same identifier to both callers.

result.title: createTask › gives concurrent callers distinct identifiers

error.message:
AssertionError: expected 1 to be 2 // Object.is equality

new Set([a.id, b.id]).size
error.snippet:
const [a, b] = await Promise.all([createTask('A'), createTask('B')])
> expect(new Set([a.id, b.id]).size).toBe(2)

diff:
diff --git a/app/server/tasks/repository.ts b/app/server/tasks/repository.ts
@@ -18,9 +18,10 @@ export async function createTask(title: string): Promise<Task> {
-  const { lastID } = await db.run('INSERT INTO tasks (title) VALUES (?)', title)
-  return getTask(lastID)
+  const next = (await db.get('SELECT MAX(id) AS m FROM tasks')).m + 1
+  await db.run('INSERT INTO tasks (id, title) VALUES (?, ?)', next, title)
+  return getTask(next)
 }
